meta.title: Leaders
meta.scope: All regular Civilization VI leaders, including DLC and Leader Pass; scenario-only leaders excluded.
meta.personas: One entry per historical person per civilization; alternate personas are combined.
meta.coordinatePolicy: Pins use the civilization/state's historical capital or principal seat during the leader's rule. If there was no fixed capital, a clearly labeled representative seat/base is used only when defensible; otherwise coords are null.
meta.capitalNamingPolicy: Capital strings use the historical city name. If the modern city name differs, it is shown as '(now <modern city>[, <modern country>])'. The modern country is omitted when it is effectively the same country represented by attrs.civilization. Leaders without a defensible fixed capital are labeled explicitly.
meta.birthYearPolicy: Negative numbers denote BCE (not astronomical year numbering). Approximate representative years are for sorting only; birthYearLabel preserves uncertainty. Unknown years are null.
meta.colorPolicy: One shared color per civilization, based on the default jersey of its original leader (Pericles for Greece). Use the primary color, or its secondary when the primary is white. Colors can repeat across civilizations because the game palette is limited.
meta.thumbnailPolicy: Paths follow the existing leader thumbnail naming. Image-source recommendations are provided separately in leader_image_sources.csv.
